import mir_eval
import numpy as np

est_intervals_adj, est_labels_adj = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    est_intervals, est_labels, 
    ref_intervals.min(), ref_intervals.max(), 
    mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD, mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD
)

intervals, ref_labels_merged, est_labels_merged = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
    ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals_adj, est_labels_adj
)

comparisons = mir_eval.chord.majmin_inv(ref_labels_merged, est_labels_merged)

durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)

assert isinstance(comparisons, np.ndarray)
assert comparisons.shape == (len(ref_labels_merged),)
assert np.all((comparisons >= 0.0) | (comparisons == -1.0))
assert 0.0 <= score <= 1.0

print(f"__CHECK__ majmin_inv {score:.4f}")
